name: Motorcycle Simulator Nebraska
summary:
Ride Omaha, Nebraska, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

58 KM ROUND OMAHA
Start in Midtown and roll I-480 through downtown under the First National and Mutual of Omaha towers. Open it up on I-80 west past Aksarben, then I-680 north up the west side and east over the Missouri on the Mormon Bridge. Run I-29 south through Iowa past Eppley Airfield and cross back on the Ford bridge past the CHI Health Center.
